keyword: has anyone ever won the masters three years in a row
claims: No golfer has ever won the Masters Tournament three consecutive years.
Jack Nicklaus won back-to-back Masters Tournaments in 1965–1966.
Nick Faldo won back-to-back Masters Tournaments in 1989–1990.
Tiger Woods won back-to-back Masters Tournaments in 2001–2002.
Rory McIlroy won back-to-back Masters Tournaments in 2025–2026.
Jack Nicklaus missed the cut in the 1967 Masters Tournament.
Nick Faldo finished T12 in the 1991 Masters Tournament.
Tiger Woods finished T15 in the 2003 Masters Tournament.
